notes:
REF-BM-02: no network fetch/metadata collection anywhere (only deps are express/sqlite/react/zod); title is entered by hand ('Titles are entered by hand in this version.'), no description/favicon/preview. REF-BM-03: nothing is auto-collected, so no auto-collected metadata to edit. REF-BM-04: url/title/tags/notes are editable but there is no description field in the model. REF-BM-06: duplicate is detected (409 + DuplicateDialog) but the dialog only offers 'Keep existing' (cancel) or 'Save another copy' — it does not converge the user to editing the existing bookmark. REF-BM-07: card shows title/notes/tags but no favicon (only a CSS 'domain-dot' placeholder) and no description. REF-BM-10: TagInput is free text with no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-14: no '#tag' search syntax; query is a plain substring LIKE. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase handling; quotes are treated literally. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag (only an isFavorite boolean and a 'Favorites only' filter, different semantics). REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk/whole-collection actions; routes act on a single id only. REF-BM-23: notes exist but are rendered as plain text (

{notes}

), no markdown rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot or Internet Archive feature. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no persisted user settings; sort is a transient filter only, no displayed-items/font-size settings.
